reference_change.title: Fixed #36960 -- Enabled the use of psycopg 3's optimized timestamp loader.

workload.source: written here from the description of https://github.com/django/django/pull/20911 (100,000 timestamptz values loaded through Django with psycopg-binary): a raw query through Django's PostgreSQL backend, eval/tasks/workloads/django-django-pr20911/bench.py, against PostgreSQL 16 in a local container

oracle.source: Django's PostgreSQL backend tests and its datetime function tests, run by its own runner against the local PostgreSQL (settings in eval/tasks/workloads/django-django-pr20911/test_postgres.py); targeted tests only

evidence.note: description, as matched by the miner: timings: 12.543 s ± 0.084 s; 4.647 s ± 0.039 s

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. PostgreSQL 16 runs in a local Docker container with trust authentication on 127.0.0.1:54329. Python and dependencies are pinned to the change's era (see eval/README.md, Built and run here)
